profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DT and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with CIK 0001773383. On its own site the company describes itself as observability built for the age of AI, offering observability, AI, automation, and application security in a single platform, and says the combination is meant to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and improve business outcomes. It also describes itself as the AI-powered observability leader.

The site frames the company's direction around preventive and autonomous observability. It quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer quote on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

No lawsuits are recorded against the company, and its law exposure is listed in Massachusetts, with 191 matters.
